result.summary: The street is a wide residential thoroughfare with sidewalks and a signalized intersection. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical medians or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure and potential vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway at the intersection requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may obstruct sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard parallel line crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to a two-lane roadway without a buffer. A wide, uncontrolled alleyway entrance creates a significant conflict zone where the sidewalk continuity is interrupted by vehicle access.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Wide Driveway
hazards.description: A wide alleyway entrance creates a large area where pedestrians must cross vehicle paths without clear priority or markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, where the alley meets the main road

hazards.name: Sidewalk Degradation
hazards.description: A large puddle and cracked pavement indicate poor drainage and surface condition, creating tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material across the alleyway entrance at a raised level to prioritize pedestrians and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the alley entrance to tighten the turning radius for vehicles and reduce the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Drainage
interventions.description: Repair the cracked sidewalk and improve drainage to eliminate standing water and tripping hazards.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road with minimal pedestrian infrastructure and no visible crossings. While sidewalks are present on both sides, they lack any buffer from high-speed traffic and are interrupted by large paved vehicle access areas.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: Sidewalks are directly adjacent to a multi-lane roadway with no physical or horizontal separation from moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked crossings or refuge islands, creating a long, unprotected path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Undefined Driveway Apron
hazards.description: A large paved area in front of the commercial building on the left creates a wide zone where vehicles can cross the sidewalk unpredictably.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground in front of the orange building

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Buffered Sidewalks
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to provide physical separation between the walkway and traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower vehicle speeds and shorten the crossing distance.

result.summary: The image depicts a multi-lane arterial roadway with a narrow sidewalk on the far side that lacks any buffer from moving traffic. There are no visible pedestrian crossings, refuge islands, or traffic calming measures, creating a high-speed environment that is hostile to non-motorized users.
